t: This is the site of XXL, a gay nightclub that catered to the bear scene. It opened in 2000, founded by Mark Ames and his then partner David Dindol. They separated in 2005, and Mark bought out his ex-partner's share. XXL was the largest dedicated bear venue in the United Kingdom, and in the world. It was also London's longest-running weekly disco, having not missed a night in over sixteen years. It's a piece of the city's gay nightlife history, built around a community that wanted a place of its own.
